## Line 568

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato, line 568](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato#L568).

```plato

    // The Frobenius norm: the square root of the sum of the squares of every
    // element (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matrix_norm). The row-major flat
    // index k maps to element (k / ColumnCount, k % ColumnCount), so the whole
    // matrix is folded in one pass.
    // Precondition: at least one element.
    FrobeniusNorm(self: IMatrix): Number
        => self.ElementCount
            .MapRange(k => self.ElementAt(k / self.ColumnCount, k % self.ColumnCount).Square)
            .Reduce(0.0, (acc, x) => acc + x)
            .Sqrt;
```
